description: Urban Development Authority - Notice of approval of the Development Plan for the Municipal Council limit of Moratuwa
categorisation: The gazette content primarily deals with the approval of a development plan for the Moratuwa Municipal Council Area. This involves land use planning and zoning changes, which falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for matters related to land development projects and urban planning. While it mentions a government minister (Mahinda Rajapaksa), the core content is about land development regulations rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
